Most patients leave hospital only partly recovered \u2014 and are left to navigate physiotherapy, nursing, medication and emotional recovery on their own. Sukino was built to change that.

As India's first continuum-of-care provider, we combine inpatient rehabilitation centres, home healthcare, palliative care and end-of-life support into a single, uninterrupted care journey \u2014 backed by an interdisciplinary team of rehabilitation physicians, palliative specialists, nurses, physiotherapists, occupational therapists, psychologists and nutritionists.

Today, families across Bangalore, Kochi and Coimbatore \u2014 and increasingly from overseas \u2014 trust Sukino to manage recovery with the same clinical rigour as a hospital, and the warmth of home.

item.title: Priya M.
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded: Sukino's team managed my father's entire recovery after his stroke — from the hospital handover to physiotherapy at home. We never felt alone.

item.title: Ramesh K.
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded: The palliative care team gave our family dignity and comfort during the hardest months of our lives. Forever grateful.

item.title: Fatima Al-Sayed
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded: We flew in from Dubai not knowing where to start. Sukino's coordinator arranged everything — visa letters, accommodation, even an Arabic-speaking nurse. My father's recovery has been remarkable.

item.title: James Whitfield
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded: From our first email to the day we flew home, Sukino's international desk was responsive and transparent about costs. The follow-up video calls after we returned to London meant everything.

item.title: What does 'continuum of care' mean?
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded: It means one care plan follows the patient from hospital discharge through rehabilitation, home healthcare and, if needed, palliative care — instead of separate providers handling each stage.

item.title: Which cities does Sukino operate in?
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded: Sukino operates inpatient rehabilitation centres and home healthcare services in Bangalore, Kochi and Coimbatore.

item.title: How do I get started with home healthcare?
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded: Share the patient's medical reports through our contact form or by phone, and a care coordinator will recommend a plan within one business day.

item.title: Do you assist with medical visas for India?
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded: Yes. Our International Patients & Family desk provides medical invitation letters and guidance on the documentation required for an Indian medical visa.

item.title: Can a family member stay with the patient during treatment?
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded: Yes, and we encourage it. We help arrange nearby guest house or serviced apartment accommodation and a dedicated family lounge at each centre.

item.title: Do you provide interpreters for non-English speaking families?
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded: Yes, professional interpreters are available for consultations and daily care updates, and several of our care coordinators are multilingual.
